is a multi-platform framework for building 2d games, interactive books, demos and other graphical applications. It is based on cocos2d-iphone, but instead of using Objective-C, it uses C++. It works on iOS, Android, Windows Phone, OS X, Windows and Linux.
It uses RapidJSON for reading/writing game assets in JSON format.

It uses RapidJSON for performance tests.

is a cross-platform framework for working with schematized data. It supports cross-language de/serialization and powerful generic mechanisms for efficiently manipulating data. Bond is broadly used at Microsoft in high scale services.

is a modern C++ REST Client library aimed at interacting with REST API's. It contains a C++ HTTP client, C++2Json/Json2C++ template based non-intrusive serialization and some high level classes to make it simple and easy to use. Works with Linux (g++, clang), macOS (clang) and Windows (MSVC).
